newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-DAY FOUR SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAY FOUR SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.

text.p: A brief selection of highlights from the fourth day of the French Open:
Best quote - "If I feel I'm struggling, I always call my daddy." Monica Seles on her relationship with father Karolj.
Stat of the day - 13. The number of double faults served by 16-year-old Venus Williams during her second-round defeat by France's Nathalie Tauziat.

Big shots - Pete Sampras and Ludmila Richterova have sent down the fastest serves so far at the French Open. The men's top seed has clocked 208 km per hour, while the 20-year-old Czech has been timed at 176 km per hour.
